subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What different themes do students raise in these open responses?

judge.implied_focus: The learning/instructional experience under remote or non-traditional (e.g., online/asynchronous) delivery, as reflected in student open responses

per_column.name: engagement_trajectory
per_column.rationale: Captures how student engagement evolved, a core facet of the remote-learning experience theme.

per_column.name: subject_format_alignment
per_column.rationale: Assesses fit between subject and delivery format, directly on the instructional-experience focus.

per_column.name: hands_on_instruction_impact
per_column.rationale: Themes the loss of practical/lab instruction under remote delivery.

per_column.name: peer_interaction_loss
per_column.rationale: Social/collaborative facet of the remote-learning experience.

per_column.name: teacher_pedagogical_strategy
per_column.rationale: Instructional adaptation facet, coherent with the focus.

per_column.name: asynchronous_format_advantage
per_column.rationale: Directly names the async delivery mode benefits, central to the inferred focus.

per_column.name: parental_involvement_demand
per_column.rationale: Home-support facet of remote learning, though heavily not_applicable/null suggesting weak grounding.

judge.rationale: The columns converge coherently on a single implied focus: the student experience of remote/online (notably asynchronous) instruction, decomposed into well-differentiated thematic facets (engagement, format fit, hands-on loss, peer interaction, teacher adaptation, async advantages, parental support). This is a genuine theme extraction rather than a grab-bag, and the facets sit at a useful granularity with categorical distinctions an analyst could act on (e.g., which subjects suffer format misalignment, where hands-on loss is critical). Weaknesses: the query only asks generically about 'themes' with no signal of remote/online context, so the system has read in a fairly specific pandemic/online-learning frame that may not be data-inferable; several columns (asynchronous_format_advantage, parental_involvement_demand) are dominated by NULL/not_applicable/not_relevant values, indicating those facets are poorly grounded in the actual responses and thin the structure. Overall a strong, coherent, actionable inferred focus with moderate over-specification and some sparsely-populated facets.
